title: I Luv U
label: XL Recordings
format: Test pressing circulated on pirate radio 2002; commercial CD single 2003

type.basis: A 2002 test pressing played on pirate radio before the 2003 single, which became Dizzee Rascal's first top 40 hit (no. 29), after Oi! had reached no. 8 in 2002.

sound.text: Opens with a stuttering voice repeating the title, then drops into a bass-heavy rhythm.
Dizzee: built on a dirty bassline and an unfamiliar kick (reused on 'Wot U On?'); strings are his attempt at the strings of 'What's Your Fantasy'.
Boy-girl call-and-response structure modelled on 'Is That Your Chick?' and 'What's Your Fantasy?'.
A 'dark tale' over a bass-heavy instrumental.

context.text: Peaked at no. 29 on the UK Singles Chart (his first top 40) and no. 5 on the UK Indie chart.
The Wire compared its impact on grime to 'Anarchy in the U.K.' for punk; named in The Pitchfork 500 (2008).
Self-produced, made earlier than the rest of Boy in da Corner, just after he dropped out of college, while on Deja Vu FM and associated with NASTY Crew.
Stereogum: one of the first grime singles to chart in the UK.
